Title: Pixel Pets
ShortDescription: A tiny pixel-art cat that lives on your desktop — it naps on your windows, wanders around, and reacts when you say hello. Pick your cat, tune its personality, and optionally care for it or watch it dream of your favorite photos.
Description:
Pixel Pets puts a tiny, hand-crafted pixel-art cat on your Windows desktop — and then lets it live its own little life.

Your cat sits on top of your windows, wanders along their edges, curls up for naps, grooms itself, and perks up when you say hello. Every cat has a personality: a sleepy one dozes the afternoon away, while an energetic one prowls, pounces, and prances across your screen. Hover to greet it, click it for a happy reaction, or pick it up and drop it wherever you like.

It's a companion, not a chore — but if you want more to do, switch on the extras:

• Care Mode — a gentle Tamagotchi layer. Feed, play with, and look after your cat by dragging treats and toys onto it. Keep it happy and healthy, or it might sulk (and need a little cone to get better).

• Dream Mode — while your cat sleeps, it dreams in little photo bubbles. Point it at your own pictures and watch them drift by above a napping kitty.

Make it yours: choose from a whole roster of cats — tabbies, tuxedos, calicos, Siamese and more — resize your pet, tune its personality, and pick which animations it plays. There's even an experimental mode to generate a pixel cat from photos of your own real-life pet.

Pixel Pets is lightweight, stays out of your way, and only catches your mouse on the cat's actual pixels — the rest of your screen works exactly as before.
Features: A hand-crafted pixel-art cat that lives on your desktop
Wanders, naps, grooms, pounces, and prances all on its own
Sits on top of and walks along your open windows
Click to react, hover to greet, drag it wherever you like
